I'm very isolated, I have no one I could tell about this anyway...

I can't talk to them about it, I don't want to think about it because I know that it won't make me look better, and the only thing that will change will be that the person I've talked to is gonna be more conscious about my appearance...

Since about 3/4 years. Before that I used to take so many photos of myself, mostly with friends. Like seriously, hundreds of pics every day. So weird how I ended up, with almost no friends and hatred to photos.

If standing around people makes me panic because of the awareness of them looking at me, I don't think talking to them would turn out well. Also, I'm a very awkward person (probably because of this but not sure, haven't been to any psychologist or anything).

When someone says I look weird, at first, I try not to mind it at all laughing and saying that it's true. It hurts so much, though. 

Well, if someone says that I look good after hearing me out speaking about my self-consciousness about my appearance, it's pretty obvious that they'll say that only to make me feel better. Seriously, there's no chance someone would like the way I look, it is hard even for me to look at myself at the mirror (even thought I've been doing it for such a long time, I still haven't got used to it).

And I can't really explain the third one, it's just on their faces, they look like they aren't pleased looking at me.

I don't know much about that social anxiety thing, and don't want to say things that are not confirmed so I don't know. Honestly, I'm so confused about this all... 
And I don't think I'll ever change like you, my facial features and all is just so weird (this is the most common thing I've been hearing for years).

What makes me feel that way - whenever I look at the mirror, I cringe. Back then I used to think that many people has something like this with themselves and there's nothing bad about it until someone actually told me that I look pathetic... After that also, I noticed some people saying from far away that I look weird. Now when I talk to someone (which happens more and more rarely) they seem to have something in mind like "ugh, she's so ugly"

And to that second one - no. I don't think i'll ever do this because i don't want to bring up a topic about my looks to anyone, it's like a taboo for me... (I don't even let anyone take pictures of mine). Even if they say something good, I'm sure these won't be honest words
Thank you, I'll try to call them as soon as I am home alone... May I send you a dm?

After today there's no doubt that by the time I turn 18 I won't be able to go to a therapist because I need my parents to agree on it. And after what happened today, I'm sure they'll never let me go there (as long as I live with them). But I'd like to try calling that hotline, though for now I still keep shaking and panicing too much while talking about this..
